HeadlineAurocAdaptive.meaning: mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule, over the 57 cells carrying both compared placements

HeadlineAurocMatched.meaning: mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the matched 0.6 rule, over the 57 cells it covers of the 59 clearing cells

PublishedAurocAdaptive.meaning: mean AUROC of the published placement at the adaptive rule, over the 57 cells carrying both compared placements

HeadlineGainAdaptiveAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC gain of the recommended placement over the published placement, both at the adaptive rule, paired over the 57 cells carrying both

HeadlineGainAdaptiveAurocLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on headline_gain_adaptive_auroc

HeadlineGainAdaptiveAurocHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on headline_gain_adaptive_auroc

HeadlineGainMatchedAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC gain of the recommended placement at the matched 0.6 rule over the published placement at the adaptive rule, paired over the 57 cells carrying both

HeadlineTprAtOnePercent.meaning: mean TPR of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule, at the 1% FPR budget, over the 57 cells it covers

HeadlineFloorAuroc.meaning: minimum single-cell AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule, over the 57 paired cells

HeadlineInversions.meaning: cells where the recommended placement at the adaptive rule scores AUROC below 0.5, out of the 57 paired cells

PrimaryGainAdaptiveAuroc.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of recommended over published, both at the adaptive rule, on the primary datasets cifar100 and tiny

HardGainAdaptiveAuroc.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of recommended over published, both at the adaptive rule, on the hard attacks

CifarOneZeroZeroOnePercentGain.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of recommended over published, both at the adaptive rule, on cifar100 at 1% poisoning only, n=4

DeploymentPrevalence.meaning: share of triggered inputs at deployment the precision macros assume

RealizedFprOneZero.meaning: mean false-positive rate on clean test images of the recommended placement at the q0.10 threshold, over 57 cells

RealizedFprOneZeroMin.meaning: lowest single-model false-positive rate at the q0.10 threshold

RealizedFprOneZeroMax.meaning: highest single-model false-positive rate at the q0.10 threshold

PrecisionOneZero.meaning: share of flags that are triggered at the q0.10 threshold when the deployment prevalence of triggered inputs is 0.01, from the mean TPR and FPR

RealizedFprTwoZero.meaning: mean false-positive rate on clean test images of the recommended placement at the q0.20 threshold, over 57 cells

RealizedFprTwoZeroMin.meaning: lowest single-model false-positive rate at the q0.20 threshold

RealizedFprTwoZeroMax.meaning: highest single-model false-positive rate at the q0.20 threshold

PrecisionTwoZero.meaning: share of flags that are triggered at the q0.20 threshold when the deployment prevalence of triggered inputs is 0.01, from the mean TPR and FPR
